en: Huh? Who's there? Can't a Gym Leader have one quiet afternoon on the cape?
text: Hm? Cine-i acolo? Nu poate un Lider de Arenă să aibă o după-amiază liniștită pe promontoriu?

en: Er... I think I'd better be going. See you, Misty!
text: Ăă... cred că mai bine plec. Pe curând, Misty!

en: He ran off! Honestly. And you're a trainer, aren't you? I can tell. You came to Cerulean for my Badge.
text: A fugit! Serios. Iar tu ești Antrenor, nu-i așa? Se vede. Ai venit la Cerulean pentru Insigna mea.

en: Fine. If my afternoon's spoiled anyway, I might as well battle. I'll be waiting at the Gym!
text: Bine. Dacă oricum mi s-a stricat după-amiaza, pot la fel de bine să lupt. Te aștept la Arenă!

en: {player}! So you followed it here too. Suicune went all the way to the end of the cape, and it won't move from there.
I think it's waiting for someone. And I'm beginning to believe that someone is you.
Go on. It's what you came for. I'll watch from here.
Suicune is waiting at the end of the cape. Go to it, {player}.
The wind off the sea fell still as Suicune turned to face {player}!
Suicune bounded away over the sea!
